data.long_meaning: The name Tiebold is derived from the Old German words 'diu' meaning 'god' and 'bold' meaning 'ruler' or 'brave'. This name was popular in Germany during the Middle Ages and was often given to sons of noble families. The name Tiebold carries the meaning “Brave ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tiebold usually hope their child will grow to embody brave ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tiebold total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
data.cultural_impact: The name Tiebold holds a rich cultural impact rooted in the Old German tradition. During the Middle Ages, names were not only a means of identification but also a reflection of social status and noble lineage. The name Tiebold would have been highly regarded among German families of noble descent, symbolizing strength, power, and a connection to the divine.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Tiebold lies in its origin as a name rooted in the Germanic belief in the supreme power and guidance of God. The name Tiebold translates to 'God's Ruler' or 'God's Brave One', which highlights the power and protection of the divine. This name reinforces the belief in God's presence in every aspect of life, instilling a sense of trust, courage, and bravery in its bearer.
